{{Top|leg}}
'''Slumm''' was a type of [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulant]] that was used to improve athletes' performance. The drug was also highly addictive, and left the user feeling tired after its effects wore off. One method of overcoming the addiction to slumm was to start taking [[Spice/Legends|spice]], an even more addictive type of drug.

Before [[Zarandro Vykas]] became a criminal, he was addicted to slumm.
